help.business: Prioritizes progress, team activity, and human decisions.
help.technical: Adds execution diagnostics, fleet, and technical capacity.

workspace.title: Working directories
workspace.hint: Local folder where agents read and write files.
workspace.empty: No working directory configured. While blank, agents use the device default directory. Enter the path to your project's local folder and save.

sandbox.title: Sandbox and unsafe mode
sandbox.acceptedAt: Unsafe mode (execution without sandbox) accepted on {{date}}.
sandbox.notAccepted: Unsafe mode not accepted — execution requires an available sandbox.
sandbox.revokeBody: Once revoked, unsafe mode will require explicit acceptance again on the next onboarding or out-of-sandbox execution. Continue?

backup.title: Backup and restore
backup.description: A backup produces a local file with the device state (database and document catalog). The file is stored in Poseidon's local data area, on your computer — nothing is sent to the cloud. Use a backup before risky changes so you can restore later.
backup.createBody: A local backup file with the device data (database and catalog) will be created on your computer. Nothing is sent to the cloud. Continue?
backup.created: Backup created on {{date}} (identifier {{id}}). Stored in Poseidon's local data area, on your computer.
backup.restoreBody: Restore the backup created on {{date}}? Current data will be replaced.

messages.catalogMissing: The document catalog has not been created yet.
messages.backupsMissing: No local backup has been created yet.
